changes: LFOs and scene locks on AMP ATK, HOLD and REL now work on FM tracks.
An LFO on PTCH now moves the pitch as far as on FLEX tracks; before it moved five times further. Saved projects with an LFO on an FM track's PTCH swing one fifth as far.
Scene locks on VOIC and CHRD now work.
VOIC, CHRD and RATO switch between scenes at the crossfader's midpoint instead of passing through the values in between.
Known issue: chip timing and full memory use are not measured.
Fixes the instrument stopping responding after changing the MIDI trig mode (#264).
Adds headroom so FM Synth no longer clips inside the machine (#273). It is about 18 dB quieter at the same mixer settings; effects and the mix can still clip.
Installs over USB beside every other module on the Modwerk beta base. Removing it after playing no longer crashes the unit.
Media and documentation only: adds a melodic audio preview, and notes that ATK 0 with a short HOLD or REL can click (#557) and that LFO1/LFO2 show FLEX's destination names (#589).
Known issue: this version has not been tested on hardware.
First Modwerk release of FM Synth, an SRC track machine that needs no sample.
Supports one to four voices, chords, glide and parameter locks.
Known issue: not yet tested on hardware.
